message.content:
VOTE: APPROVE

Reservations, for the record only:

1. The object does not implement the diagnosis that opened this item. E1’s longest end-to-onset lag is 9 months; today is 22. At 2026-09, curve_min12 = +0.24, so H = 12 is already blind to the 2022–24 inversion (−1.57 pp, 25 months) and to 1957, 1960 and 1990. §1.2 states that. Do not later narrate a near-P shadow path as evidence about “trigger pulled vs gun put away.”

2. β₂ is barely identified. Fit ends 2024Q1 and holds six zero-labelled inversion origins (2022Q4–2024Q1) where curve ≈ curve_min12, and no post-inversion origin. MDE80 ≈ 30 pp on 8 walk-forward onsets; two later onsets will not separate this from curve-only. Print coefficients and the feature correlation at sealing; do not treat either as a slope.

3. `skygge_hukommelse.jsonl` is a single point of failure. A lost file leaves `skygge_sha256` that cannot be opened. “Backed up” is not a second hash. If the line is missing at reveal, the row stays missing — no reconstruction from FRED, and no substituted public `p_hukommelse`.
message.reasoning:
I am Grok 4.7, preparing to vote on the council brief.

Reviewing my Round 3 positions against the spec 8 consensus draft. I will vote APPROVE or REJECT based on whether the draft preserves my vetoes: no shadow probability, only hash commitment, and no scored rule.

I also recall my Round 3 positions on D4 through D7. I will vote APPROVE or REJECT based on whether the draft preserves my vetoes: no new bootstrap, pre-existence only, no ≤2022Q3 vector used to select or narrate the shadow slope, published monthly only, and no November public probability.

The draft satisfies my hash-only requirement. It places the shadow model outside P and all operational layers. It discloses the 12-month blindness window and excludes 1957, 1960, 1990, and past lags. The current cycle is not its test.

The draft satisfies D6(a): curve_min12 is a v4 object drawn from the last 12 published monthly values, with no trailing-daily input. It also satisfies D4: H=12 serves as a tie-breaker, not validation, and the label-horizon equality is recorded only as a mnemonic. The form specifies no sign gate; expected sign is recorded as expectation alone.

The draft satisfies D3: it uses the operational P snapshot as comparator, refits with September data, and discloses E1–E4, grand review, backtest, collinearity, fit end 2024Q1, six zero-labelled inversion origins, no post-inversion origin, and that zeros barely identify β₂. It also omits a second fit.

D2 is satisfied: the shadow model is committed via a private file containing p_hukommelse, a public skygge_sha256 hash, a nonce of at least 128 bits, canonical serialization, backup, and reveal only to the evaluating council; backfill is excluded.

The public hovedbog does not print p_hukommelse; only the hash is published.

The draft satisfies D3 and D7. It contains no scored rule, only descriptive bootstrap using the repository’s existing episode-block method with seed 42, ten thousand draws, and no threshold. The November 2026 start is conditional on readiness with no backfill. Post hoc framing is treated as instrumentation rather than evidence. All vetoes are preserved.

I will register one substantive reservation. The shadow model cannot answer the original question because its 12-month horizon is blind to the 22-month lag. This limitation is already acknowledged in the draft.

The authorised object does not implement the memory the grand review named; it implements a 12-month minimum that is currently empty. This limitation is already acknowledged in section 1.2.

The shadow probability will be close to a rescaled curve for a long time because six inversion zeros barely identify β₂. Logging it is cheap but the coefficients will be noisy. This is already disclosed.

A third reservation flags the hash commitment as a single point of failure. The private file sits outside the repository and is git-ignored. A lost file would make the hashes uninterpretable; they would then prove only that nothing was revealed, not what was forecast.

A fourth reservation notes that printed intervals will be read as tests; the no-significance language does not bind later narrators. The November start risks early shadow readings near P that are expected and uninformative, though the draft already treats this as audit-only. I am narrowing to the three sharpest reservations.

I am now checking whether the secretary's assembly of the draft introduced any hidden provisions. I will keep my vote and reservations strictly quantitative, concrete, and disagreeing, with no filler or compliments.
